repo_notes.content: This public repository is an independent synthetic interview simulation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bank of America and contains no Bank of America production code, customer data, credentials, systems, logos or proprietary design assets. Prioritize the shared transfer feature, the custom design system over Angular Material, the local integration ports, both full applications and the five downstream compatibility fixtures.
repo_notes.author: Synthetic demo maintainers

repo_notes.content: Treat Angular 18 as the checkpoint required by the interview case, not as a current production recommendation. The public main branch is the Angular 14 baseline. Preserve the shared public contract and stop before merge or deployment.
repo_notes.author: Synthetic demo maintainers

repo_notes.content: Treat the Angular runtime as browser-based Online Banking. Responsive mobile evidence validates that web surface only. Read config/digital-channel-boundaries.json before describing iOS or Android: both are adjacent channels whose implementations are not asserted and neither consumes the Angular library in this model.
